12.30 P. M.  Washington July 8th 1863
For Anna period There is reliable
information that the enemy is crossing
at Williamsport period The opportunity to
wales his divided forces should not
be lost period Adam is urgent
and anxious that your army should
move against him by forced marches
applause very rainy and warm Viola


1.45  Washington July 8. 1863.
For Bengal Oakum period I fear
your paroling the garrison at Oakum
without actual delivery to a proper
agent as required by the seventh
article of the cartel may be
construed into an absolute release and
that these men will be immediately
placed in the ranks of the 
wiley period such has been the
case elsewhere period If these prisoners
have not been allowed to depart
you will retain them till further
orders signed Applause hold the rebs
